name: axis-05-bosl2-white
version_tag: MECHANICAL CALENDAR AXIS — BOSL2 REGENERATED PARTS, white PLA Basic (tray 0): mainaxis_extended_1 + nut + jamnut. Replaces PRINT_PLATE_white.stl, whose thread measured pitch 2.0 and ~0.46mm radial clearance against a brief calling for M11x2.5 with 0.15mm. The new mainaxis_bosl2.scad sets thr_d 11.0, thr_pitch 2.5, SLOP 0.15, nut_af 18, nut_h 8, jam_h 5, and the exported mesh agrees: top thread major dia 11.00, minor 8.30, depth 1.35mm radial (was 1.16mm at pitch 2.0), so the profile is coarser and chunkier and stands a better chance. SUPPORTS OFF — non-negotiable. Auto supports were the original failure: they climb the model and pack the thread valleys, 0.53g into the nut bores alone, which is why the threads read as missing. THE REAL FAILURE ON THE LAST BUILD WAS COOLING, NOT SUPPORT. Photographed evidence: bottom thread clean, top thread shredded into furry smeared crests, flange below it smooth. Measured cause: above z~28 the nuts and washer have finished and the bolt prints ALONE as a dia-11 column, so layer time collapses to 4.0s — exactly the slow_down_layer_time floor — while the nozzle drives at 200mm/s with 5000 accel 97mm up a slender shaft. The bottom thread survived on 5.5s layers because it is fatter, shorter, near the bed and shares layer time with the other objects. FIX: slow_down_layer_time 4 -> 20 stretches only the small-cross-section layers, which targets the top of the bolt and leaves the fat lower sections alone; outer wall 200 -> 120 and accel 5000 -> 2000 cut ringing on the tall column. This DELIBERATELY departs from the brief's 'standard speed, not a slow preset' — a slender 97mm tower with 1.35mm thread crests is precisely the case stock Standard does not suit. BRIM 8mm: bolt is 97mm on 380mm2 of contact, ratio 4, worse than main-axis at 5 and far worse than the month drum at 79 that detached. Nuts are ratio 12 and 20, also below the line. Full part cooling (fan 100) comes from the stock PLA profile and was already in force. Layout keeps 8mm brims from merging: bolt brim spans x82-128, nuts x141.7-178.3.
